name: Chug Cab
description: The cabinet Chug Rig comes with, for any amplifier: a full low end round 200 Hz, a lean middle, and a top that falls away steeply above 4 kHz. Tight, heavy rhythm.

name: Djent Clean Cab
description: Djent Amp's clean cabinet: its warmth in the low middle round 400 Hz rather than in the lows, for clean arpeggios and chords.

name: Djent Lead Cab
description: Djent Amp's lead cabinet: full lows round 190 Hz, a lean 1 kHz, and a smooth top, for singing leads.

name: Djent Rhythm Cab
description: Djent Amp's rhythm cabinet: lows round 135 Hz, less at 500 Hz, and an open 2 to 3 kHz: tight, articulate rhythm on extended-range guitars.

name: Flipside 1x15
description: Flipside Bass Combo's fifteen in its sealed box: round lows near 100 Hz, an even middle, and almost no top: the old studio bass sound.

name: Forward
description: The forward 4x12: a closed box of four twelves with a microphone close to a cone, its upper middle forward and its top falling away above 5 kHz. It cuts through a band.

name: Forward, Cap
description: The forward 4x12 with the microphone toward the cone's centre: the top falls off higher, and more of 4 to 6 kHz comes through. For a dark amplifier, or a lead that has to be heard.

name: Forward, Edge
description: The forward 4x12 with the microphone toward the cone's edge: the top falls off sooner, and the fizz of a high gain goes with it.

name: Forward, Tight
description: The forward 4x12 as a smaller, damped box with a low cut at 90 Hz: less boom under fast, muted playing, and room left for a bass.

name: Halfglow 8x10
description: Halfglow Bass Head's eight tens: lows round 150 Hz and a dip from 1 to 2 kHz.

name: Icebox 8x10
description: Icebox Bass Stack's eight tens: deep lows round 90 Hz, less at 1 kHz, and more top than the other cabinets, for a bass that growls.

name: Leviathan Clean Cab
description: The cabinet Leviathan Rig's clean amp comes with: a gentle bump round 240 Hz and a top that stays open longer than most, for clean and edge-of-break-up guitar.

name: Leviathan Hot Cab
description: The cabinet Leviathan Rig's high-gain amp comes with: full lows round 180 Hz, an even middle, and presence round 3.5 kHz.

name: Leviathan Rust Cab
description: The cabinet Leviathan Rig's crunch amp comes with: firm lows round 190 Hz and a lean middle.

name: Thick
description: The thick 4x12: more from 150 to 400 Hz and less from 1 to 2 kHz than the forward one, and a top that falls off sooner. Heavy chords sound large through it.

name: Thick, Big Box
description: The thick 4x12 as a larger box that rings more at its resonance: the lows reach further down and bloom. For slow, heavy playing with nothing else in the low end.

name: Thick, Cap
description: The thick 4x12 with the microphone toward the cone's centre, which gives its dark top some of its edge back.

name: Thick, In a Mix
description: The thick 4x12 with a low cut at 100 Hz and a high cut at 9 kHz, and the microphone a little toward the centre: what two rhythm guitars need of it beside a bass and cymbals.

name: Untitled Cab
description: The cabinet Untitled Amp comes with: lows round 170 Hz, an even middle, and a top that falls away above 4 kHz.
